taxModel.roomTaxBasis: Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%, published in The Venetian's official hotel terms and conditions: 'Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%.'
taxModel.appliesTo: the nightly room rate and the resort fee (the resort fee line '$55 plus applicable tax' and the Caesars fee line '$62.30 ($54.95 plus $7.35 tax)' both show the fee taxed at the same 13.38%)
taxModel.note: True nightly cost in this dashboard is computed as (published nightly rate including the resort fee) x 1.1338. It is an arithmetic restatement of the published rate and the published tax rate, not a quote. The published booking pages state 'Excludes Taxes', so the final folio can differ.
